definitions.gloss: heterosexuality; attraction to the opposite sex
definitions.explanation: Sexual or romantic attraction to people of the opposite sex. Used in academic, medical, and social discourse about sexual orientation.

examples.japanese: {異性愛|いせいあい}は{性的指向|せいてきしこう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Heterosexuality is one type of sexual orientation.

examples.japanese: {異性愛|いせいあい}を{前提|ぜんてい}とした{社会|しゃかい}の{見方|みかた}が{見直|みなお}されている。
examples.english: Social perspectives that assume heterosexuality are being reconsidered.

examples.japanese: {性的指向|せいてきしこう}には{異性愛|いせいあい}、{同性愛|どうせいあい}、{両性愛|りょうせいあい}などがあり、{多様性|たようせい}を{尊重|そんちょう}する{意識|いしき}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Sexual orientations include heterosexuality, homosexuality, and bisexuality, among others, and awareness of respecting this diversity is spreading.

notes:
A compound of {異性|いせい} (the opposite sex) and {愛|あい} (love). The related adjective form is {異性愛|いせいあい}の, and a person of this orientation is called {異性愛者|いせいあいしゃ} (heterosexual person).

This term is neutral and used in formal, academic, and journalistic contexts. In casual speech, ストレート (straight) is also sometimes used as an English loanword.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異性愛者|いせいあいしゃ}: heterosexual person
- {異性愛|いせいあい}を{前提|ぜんてい}とする: to assume heterosexuality
- {異性愛|いせいあい}{規範|きはん}: heteronormativity
- {異性愛|いせいあい}{中心|ちゅうしん}の: heterocentric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同性愛|どうせいあい}: homosexuality — attraction to the same sex
- {両性愛|りょうせいあい}: bisexuality — attraction to both sexes
- {性的指向|せいてきしこう}: sexual orientation — the umbrella concept
